_README: SPREADSHEET-INFERRED TEST INVENTORY. Not authoritative. Generated by scripts/build-test-catalogue.py from two Sterling product spreadsheets.

_provenance.whatThisIs: A static test inventory so the Generator can be exercised against a broad range of REAL Sterling part numbers and REALISTIC dimensions before live designCentral access exists.
_provenance.whatThisIsNot: It is NOT designCentral and does not reproduce it. Part numbers, names and the SKU/parent relationships come from the spreadsheets. Everything else - dimensions, shape, pages, bleed, margins, designer mode, orientation and the id - is INFERRED by test-only rules documented in the builder.
_provenance.ids: Synthetic and NEGATIVE. designCentral ids are positive AUTO_INCREMENT, so a negative id can never be mistaken for or collide with a real one. Inferred products therefore contribute no productList entry to a pushed package; their real part number still travels.
_provenance.commercialData: Both spreadsheets contain price, e-price and cost columns. None of it is read by the builder or present in this file.
_provenance.verifiedRecordsElsewhere: The CMS-verified record (6505 / BCDP-CM) lives in data/sterling-products.json and is not produced here.
_provenance.replacement: A live SterlingProductProvider replaces every inferred value without the Generator UI changing. The inference rules live only in the builder and the catalogue provider.
_provenance.dpiConvention: px = inches * 96; mm converted as mm * 96 / 25.4.
